Elliot (new-hire): hey team, day 2 here. i'm blocked on two things: Console staging admin and prod read-only so i can shadow a rollout. who should i ask? :wave:
Becca (people-ops): welcome Elliot! cc your manager in a short access request ticket and tag me, i'll route it. do you have your SSO email ready?
Elliot (new-hire): elliot@redwood.ai — thanks.
Marcos (infra): staging is quick, i can add you to the `feature-flags-devs` group. prod requires completion of the safety checklist + manager ok.
Elliot (new-hire): what's in the safety checklist?
Tanya (security): quick checklist: security orientation done, MFA confirmed, short review of flag rollback runbook, and manager attestation that you need prod access.
Elliot (new-hire): got it. i'll ping my manager. can you add me to staging now so i can start testing?
Marcos (infra): done — added to `feature-flags-devs` and granted Console role `staging-operator`. should propagate in 20s.
access-bot: Access ticket auto: ACC-8022 created by Elliot at 2026-03-23T11:08:00Z.
Elliot (new-hire): i'm seeing the staging role. quick question: is there a non-destructive preview mode for rollouts?
Marcos (infra): yeah, in the flags UI pick "dry-run" then preview traffic slices. for CLI try `redwood-ff preview --id <rollout-id>`.
Elliot (new-hire): sweet. filing the prod request now with manager CC and checklist filled.
Becca (people-ops): once manager approves i'll mark it for Tanya to review.
Tanya (security): once you finish orientation ping me and i'll sign-off for the prod viewer role. if you need temporary elevated prod write access later, we'll require a paired oncall + 1-hour window noted in the issue.
Elliot (new-hire): thanks everyone — that unblocks my first-week testing. appreciate the quick responses.
Marcos (infra): welcome aboard! holler if the flags UI behaves oddly, i've seen a small caching quirk on older browsers.
Elliot (new-hire): noted, using latest Chrome. thanks.
